phrase: a Copper and Brass Kitchenware Brand
verdict: Yes. PTal from Amritsar pitched copper, brass and bronze kitchenware on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from all five sharks. Traditional metal utensils are coming back as buyers look for healthier cookware, and clusters like Jandiala Guru near Amritsar have the craft skills.
angle: Copper bottles, brass plates and bronze (kansa) utensils sell to health-conscious buyers and wedding and festival gift buyers. Buying directly from the Thathera craftsmen of Jandiala Guru or Moradabad's makers keeps costs low. Tinning, care instructions and quality control decide repeat purchases.
